description: This PHP class defines a data model 'EmployeeSalaryModel' used for serialization and API responses related to employee salary information in the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties such as salary amount, pay period, pay grade, currency, and direct debit details, and makes use of traits and annotations for serialization and API schema documentation.
